title: Tripwire Funnel Stencil
conversionGoal: Convert visitors on a low-friction, urgency-led offer before routing them into a fuller purchase flow.
notes: Normalized from sales, CTA, pricing, and urgency-oriented component patterns.
Countdown and guarantee remain structural only, with no real timers or marketing effects copied from the sources.
The funnel stays intentionally short to preserve the tripwire conversion logic.

sources.notes: Confirmed highlighted pricing and sale CTA patterns that reduce into offer-plus-checkout structure.
Provided urgency-led CTA cadence that normalizes into a simple offer section.
Confirmed a concise conversion-focused CTA block suitable for short-form offer funnels.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: Present the low-friction offer and direct toward purchase.

sections.name: CountdownOffer
sections.purpose: Represent urgency or limited availability without shipping a real timer implementation.

sections.name: ProofStrip
sections.purpose: Add quick trust markers before the checkout jump.

sections.name: BenefitsSection
sections.purpose: Clarify the immediate value of the offer.

sections.name: GuaranteeSection
sections.purpose: Reduce purchase risk for a quick-buy offer.

sections.name: CheckoutPanel
sections.purpose: Capture buyer details and confirm the tripwire purchase.

sections.name: CTASection
sections.purpose: Repeat the immediate purchase action on the landing page.

sections.name: ConfirmationPanel
sections.purpose: Confirm the tripwire purchase and set next expectations.

pages.name: LandingPage
pages.goal: Drive the visitor from interest into the offer checkout quickly.

pages.name: ThankYouPage
pages.goal: Confirm the purchase and prepare the follow-up offer or delivery.
